title: Audio Studio Workspace, Session Graph & Authority

selection_trigger.rationale: Live terminal checkpoints prove MNCS-24 and MAS-21 completed. MSAS start requirements are satisfied by completed ARI/MIB/SMB01-07/CNI/PCA/MCS/MCCS/MNCS/MAS/AAI foundations plus available DWC speech pronunciation/acoustic contracts. MRCS is DAG-parallel-safe with MSAS, but this product-development selector follows the existing MAS→MSAS serial route approved by the owner.
selection_trigger.product_start_freeze: OPS3-08 must close before governed start.

objective: Establish the integrated Sound & Audio Studio workspace, session graph and authority boundaries over existing AAI/PCA/DWC/resource/runtime contracts without duplicating canonical audio, world, event, or speech authority.
boundaries: AAI remains audio asset/cue/playback/mixer/interoperability authority; MSAS owns integrated creator workflow and semantic production UX.
DWC speech retains constructed-language pronunciation, exact-ID and governed acoustic-model authority; MSAS consumes its contracts without requiring a currently promoted acoustic candidate.
ARI retains resource identity, rights and derivative lineage; World/Environment/Scene/Adventure/Combat/Dialogue/Action/Event owners retain canonical state/event truth.
Blocking workflows remain local-first and cannot require a paid/cloud audio or voice provider.
MRCS is DAG-parallel-safe with MSAS but is not started by this selection.
MSAS-03+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
next_action: After OPS3-08 closeout clears the repair freeze, a later product-development owner Continue may govern-start MSAS-01 under the protected-main FIFO. Do not start it during OPS3-08.
